english:
<void Void /> Weapon Kills progress a Counter while <void Devour /> is active, spawning a <void Void Breach /> at 100% Counter Progress.

Counter Progress per Kill, based on <link Enemy Rank [#CombatantClassifications] />:
• Rank-and-File: 16.7%
• Elites: 34%
• Minibosses and above: 50%
• Guardians: ?%

Collecting a <void Void Breach /> grants 20 Handling and 20 Reload Speed for 10 seconds, and refills the magazines of Shotguns and Grenade Launchers.

source.text:
While Devour is active:

Void Weapon Kills progress a counter that spawns a Void Breach upon reaching 100%.
RnF = 16.7% | Elite = 34% | Miniboss+ = 50% | Guardians = ?%

On Void Breach Pickup:
+20 Handling and +20 Reload Speed for 10 seconds.
Refills Shotguns and Grenade Launchers.
